video_title: The NBA Is BACK! Road Trippin’ Locks In MVP, DPOY & Championship Picks

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins argues Tyrese Haliburton deserves more recognition
quotes.excerpt: When we mention Anthony Edwards, when we mention Luka Doncic, when we mention Jalen Brunson, we need to mention Tyrese Haliburton.
quotes.quote: When we mention Anthony Edwards, when we mention Luka Doncic, when we mention Jalen Brunson, we need to mention Tyrese Haliburton.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins questions Jalen Duren's contract value compared to Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.excerpt: You can't pay Jalen Duren $200 million and ask Karl-Anthony Towns to take the same $200 million.
quotes.quote: You can't pay Jalen Duren $200 million and ask Karl-Anthony Towns to take the same $200 million.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins claims Chicago has found their next Derrick Rose
quotes.excerpt: Chicago has finally found their next Derrick Rose.
quotes.quote: Chicago has finally found their next Derrick Rose.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye and Richard Jefferson debate double-teaming in basketball

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: Channing is like, don't double-team and pick up. But now, think about it. If you are going to play in a game and the other opposing team is going to double-team, shouldn't you be prepared for that?

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: Yeah, but don't double-team the whole time. We double-team Shaq the whole time. Like, you got to.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins apologizes for calling Tyrese Haliburton overrated
quotes.excerpt: I was one of those guys that two years ago, I called Tyrese Haliburton overrated. I apologize to him on national television.
quotes.quote: I was one of those guys that two years ago, I called Tyrese Haliburton overrated. I apologize to him on national television.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins ranks Tyrese Haliburton as a top-10 NBA player
quotes.excerpt: He is a top-10 player in the NBA. If I'm starting a team, I would start a team with him over Donovan Mitchell, I would start a team with him over Kevin Durant, I would start a team with him over Devin Booker.
quotes.quote: He is a top-10 player in the NBA. If I'm starting a team, I would start a team with him over Donovan Mitchell, I would start a team with him over Kevin Durant, I would start a team with him over Devin Booker.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson analyzes the Indiana Pacers' offensive efficiency
quotes.excerpt: I watched the Indiana Pacers against the Minnesota Timberwolves have 20 made field goals on 19 assists.
quotes.quote: I watched the Indiana Pacers against the Minnesota Timberwolves have 20 made field goals on 19 assists. And for them to play that way, that style already, that means every shot they made was assisted except for one.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson discusses Tyrese Haliburton's feeling of disrespect
quotes.excerpt: Tyrese already started off with the disrespect. He feels disrespected. When Jason Tatum came back, when certain players came back, there was a celebration of welcome back to basketball.
quotes.quote: Tyrese already started off with the disrespect. He feels disrespected. When Jason Tatum came back, when certain players came back, there was a celebration of welcome back to basketball. So for him, he's already looking at the schedule like, dang, I don't even remember where they're opening up at.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on trash-talking Tyrese Haliburton about his tour dates
quotes.excerpt: I was talking about his tour dates. I was saying all sorts of stuff to Tyrese. That's my guy.
quotes.quote: I was talking about his tour dates. I was saying all sorts of stuff to Tyrese. That's my guy. But I was like, yo, you're the best player. You can't put up tour dates. He's got 8, 7, and 6. You can't put up tour dates in the NBA Finals as the best player.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.excerpt: I'm telling you, 83, low 80s. That's disrespectful. When you're, when it, I wasn't trying to be disrespectful for my, some players the game, so I know like I was rating for.
quotes.quote: I'm telling you, 83, low 80s. That's disrespectful. When you're, when it, I wasn't trying to be disrespectful for my, some players the game, so I know like I was rating for.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the necessity of player sacrifices for winning
quotes.excerpt: I do believe that a player, if they want a championship, the goal is winning. And then players are expected to make sacrifices to maintain the winning.
quotes.quote: I do believe that a player, if they want a championship, the goal is winning. And then players are expected to make sacrifices to maintain the winning. And it's really the only thing in professional business where you're asked to take less in order to preserve the win for the owner.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the value of De'Aaron Fox
quotes.excerpt: He's too expensive to sit down and your two young guys are too good to keep them on the bench.
quotes.quote: He's too expensive to sit down and your two young guys are too good to keep them on the bench. So you can't devalue De'Aaron Fox, right? Even though Harper and Castle should be the two guards, you can't put De'Aaron Fox on the bench because now your $200 million player is a $200 million bench guy.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Karl-Anthony Towns as a 'play-through' player
quotes.excerpt: Karl-Anthony Towns, we all agree, is a play-through guy. You can play through him. He's proven.
quotes.quote: Karl-Anthony Towns, we all agree, is a play-through guy. You can play through him. He's proven. Karl-Anthony Towns exposed the Defensive Player of the Year on the biggest stage.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the importance of getting paid
quotes.excerpt: First priority always been that for me, even when I was a vet, young guys coming into the league, first thing first, get your money.
quotes.quote: First priority always been that for me, even when I was a vet, young guys coming into the league, first thing first, get your money. This is a job. Get your money.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Jalen Brunson as the best player
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson is the best player, obviously. Karl-Anthony Towns is the most important player.
quotes.quote: Jalen Brunson is the best player, obviously. Karl-Anthony Towns is the most important player. Go and look at that run. Look at the adjustments that Mitch Johnson had to make.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on LeBron James's versatility
quotes.excerpt: LeBron James is the greatest player of all time because of him being able to be versatile.
quotes.quote: LeBron James is the greatest player of all time because of him being able to be versatile. And we have seen at times when he's been asked to play the center position, he plays at the highest level.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the difficulty of ranking NBA teams
quotes.excerpt: Can I get a trash bin to put all these teams in?
quotes.quote: Can I get a trash bin to put all these teams in? This might be the hardest question. This is harder than like, who's your championship pick?

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the necessity of team health for success
quotes.excerpt: Whoever's the healthiest team at the end, that's really it. It just comes down to the mix.
quotes.quote: Whoever's the healthiest team at the end, that's really it. It just comes down to the mix. We're primarily healthy at the end. San Antonio was healthy at the end.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the importance of team identity
quotes.excerpt: They finally have gotten the guys that they really want to develop and believe in.
quotes.quote: They finally have gotten the guys that they really want to develop and believe in. They've had some injuries last year. Obviously, it started off with Trey Young. Now they have a new identity. Quinn Snyder has been trying to fit what Trey Young can do with what this young team is, and now that they have a whole team of what they are, I think you're going to see the best version of them this year.
